skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Starry Night Sky
skins.content: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Grimoire of Dark Law' Custom Line/Starry Night Sky. He plays the role of the guide showing the hero the way. The Golden Movement has long since faded, but the stars he shoots will forever point true north.
skins.quote: After the transfiguration of his tuba, Bassline lets out a rare smile of pure joy as he flies through the air with everyone's help. With a wave of his wand, stars appear in the sky.
